review_notes: Read the whole target file. Inside it, the collision proof does repeat the eval₂ data three times, but that is routine. The real duplication is across files. The same injective-case factorization of `rename f` appears in RenameFlatness.lean (rename_flat_of_injective), RenameSmooth.lean (rename_smooth_iff) and this file. I compared the three copies and they are textually identical up to the property being transferred. I did not check RenameBasis.lean in detail, and I did not check whether the tests directory has more copies. The proposed lemma is untested, and I did not confirm the exact instance paths. In particular, `Equiv.ofInjective` would need `classical`-free elaboration, and `renameEquiv` coercions may need small adjustments.

findings.problem: The injective-case proof first builds `hrename` and `hcomp`. Together they prove that `rename f` equals `e₂.symm ∘ C ∘ e₁` as a ring hom, where `e₁` is the renaming equivalence onto `Set.range f` and `e₂` is `splitComplAlgEquiv`. This is nontrivial mathematical content. The same ~25 lines are copy-pasted in RenameFlatness.lean (`rename_flat_of_injective`) and RenameSmooth.lean (`rename_smooth_iff`, injective branch). Only the property transferred differs: Flat, Smooth, FormallySmooth. The `hC` / `h₁` / `rw [← hcomp]` / `.comp` tail is also parallel in all three. Any fix to the factorization must be made three times.
findings.proposed_change: Add one public lemma next to `splitComplAlgEquiv` in RenameComplement.lean. It would state: for `f : σ → τ` injective, there are ring equivalences `e₁ : MvPolynomial σ R ≃+* MvPolynomial (Set.range f) R` and `e₂ : MvPolynomial (Set.range f ᶜ-split…) ≃+* MvPolynomial τ R` such that `(rename (R := R) f).toRingHom = e₂.toRingHom.comp ((C : MvPolynomial (Set.range f) R →+* MvPolynomial ((Set.range f)ᶜ : Set τ) (MvPolynomial (Set.range f) R)).comp e₁.toRingHom)`. Concretely, take `e₁ := (renameEquiv R (Equiv.ofInjective f hf)).toRingEquiv` and `e₂ := (splitComplAlgEquiv (R := R) (Set.range f)).symm.toRingEquiv`. The proof is the current `hrename` and `hcomp` block: use `algHom_ext`, then `splitComplAlgEquiv_rename_subtypeVal`. Here the target proof reduces to `rw [Lemma]` followed by `(h₁.comp hC).comp (of_bijective e₂.bijective)`, with `hC` from `RingHom.formallySmooth_algebraMap`. The Flat and Smooth proofs reduce the same way.
findings.benefit: The factorization is proved once and the three results become short transfer arguments. This removes about 50 duplicated lines. Readers see directly that the three proofs differ only in the property being transferred. Maintenance changes to `splitComplAlgEquiv` or `renameEquiv` then touch one place.
